data.name: Kabir Singh
data.quote: Found my riding crew for Spiti in a week. The route notes saved us twice on Kunzum La.

data.name: Ananya Rao
data.quote: As a solo woman rider, verified clubs and live ride tracking make every weekend ride feel safe.

data.name: Rohan Mehta
data.quote: Rented a bike in Goa for India Bike Week straight from the app. Zero hassle.

data.name: Shashank T.
data.quote: Logged 40,000 km on TGB routes. The fuel-stop and stay notes on the Ladakh loop are gold.

data.name: Meera Iyer
data.quote: My first track day was booked, paid and confirmed in minutes. The members-only slots are worth it.

data.name: Varsha Pillai
data.quote: Got my Interceptor serviced through the app before a Coorg ride. Transparent pricing, on-time pickup.

data.name: Arjun Nair
data.quote: Our club went from WhatsApp chaos to one place for members, rides and tickets. Turnout doubled.

data.name: Priya Sharma
data.quote: Joined a Rann Utsav group ride with strangers and came back with friends for life.
